mapper.select: SELECT * FROM product_images WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND media_status = 'APPROVED'::media_status AND scan_status = 'CLEAN'::media_scan_status ORDER BY position ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_images ( id, product_id, object_key, alt_text, role, position, media_status, scan_status, scanned_at, rejected_reason, uploaded_by, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, version, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{productId}, #{objectKey}, #{altText}, #{role}::image_role, #{position}, #{mediaStatus}::media_status, #{scanStatus}::media_scan_status, #{scannedAt}, #{rejectedReason}, #{uploadedBy}, #{reviewedBy}, #{reviewedAt}, 0, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE product_images SET alt_text = #{altText}, role = #{role}::image_role, position = #{position}, media_status = #{mediaStatus}::media_status, scan_status = #{scanStatus}::media_scan_status, scanned_at = #{scannedAt}, rejected_reason = #{rejectedReason}, uploaded_by = #{uploadedBy}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = #{reviewedAt}, version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version}

UPDATE product_images SET scan_status = #{scanStatus}::media_scan_status, media_status = #{mediaStatus}::media_status, scanned_at = #{scannedAt}, version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE product_images SET role = 'GALLERY'::image_role, version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND role = 'COVER'::image_role AND media_status = 'APPROVED'::media_status AND scan_status = 'CLEAN'::media_scan_status
AND id != #{excludeId}
